purpose: Registry of authorized discovery sources. This registry describes source coverage; it does not claim that every source is already connected or that every record is a verified offer.

sourceTypes.publicBuyer: Public procurement notices and public buyer demand
sourceTypes.privateBuyer: Private-sector requests for quotation or purchasing needs
sourceTypes.surplusSeller: Private surplus, excess inventory, liquidation or end-of-line stock offers

sources.name: Open Contracting Partnership Data Registry
sources.coverage: Global; datasets from 100+ publishers and 100+ countries/regions, depending on publisher coverage
sources.access: Bulk downloads in JSON, CSV and Excel; dataset-specific access methods
sources.notes: Use this registry to discover country publishers. Inspect each dataset's freshness, licence, fields and coverage before activating an adapter.

sources.name: Tenders Electronic Daily (TED) Search API and Open Data
sources.coverage: European Union public procurement notices and related data
sources.access: Official search API and open data services
sources.notes: Use as a regional source and deduplicate against national portals.

sources.name: BOAMP / DILA Open Data
sources.notes: The existing collector and GitHub Actions workflow must pass a real run before this source is marked active.

sources.name: SIMAP
sources.access: Official procurement portal; API access and terms must be checked before implementation
sources.notes: Do not assume unrestricted API access; verify authentication, licence and permitted reuse.

sources.name: World Bank Global Public Procurement Database
sources.coverage: Global procurement-system directory and reference information
sources.access: Public information and downloadable reference material
sources.notes: Useful for mapping country procurement systems; not a universal live tender feed.

sources.name: Private surplus seller feeds and partner marketplaces
sources.coverage: Global, only where a seller or marketplace grants access
sources.access: Seller-submitted listings, partner API, licensed feed or explicit permission
sources.notes: No scraping behind login, bypassing access controls or reusing listings contrary to platform terms. Stock, quantity, price and availability require seller confirmation.

sources.name: Private buyer RFQ and purchasing-need feeds
sources.coverage: Global, only where the buyer or platform grants access
sources.access: Buyer-submitted requests, partner API, licensed feed or explicit permission
sources.notes: Treat discovered demand as a lead until the buyer confirms it is current and genuine.

sources.name: Business directories and company registers
sources.access: Official open registers or licensed providers, subject to local law and terms
sources.notes: Use only for company qualification and lawful business contact; a directory entry is not proof of buyer intent or available stock.

normalization.matchingPolicy: Never treat a public tender as a surplus-stock offer. Never treat a directory listing as confirmed demand or stock. Match buyer and seller leads separately, then require party confirmation.
